declare

begin

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
the_rowcount NUMBER := 0;
 temp NUMBER ;
 v_lov boolean; 
BEGIN
 if :show_term = 'N' then
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO TEMP FROM SPONSORS
 WHERE SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate +1);
 IF TEMP <= 0 THEN
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_sponsor');
 else
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve'); 
 end if;
 elsif :show_term = 'Y' then
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO TEMP FROM SPONSORS
 WHERE SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 IF TEMP <= 0 THEN
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_sponsor_term');
 else
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve'); 
 end if;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
 where_clause varchar2(500);
 where_clause_1 varchar2(200);
BEGIN
 if :show_term = 'Y' then
 where_clause := ' chapter_id = :global.chapter_id '||
 ' and (sponsor_id = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id '||
 ' or name like decode(:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id, null, ';
 where_clause_1 := ' ''%'''||','||'''%'''||'||'||':ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id'||'||'||'''%'''||')'||') ';
 where_clause := where_clause||where_clause_1;
 elsif :show_term = 'N' then
 where_clause := ' chapter_id = :global.chapter_id '||
 ' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate +1) '||
 ' and (sponsor_id = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id '||
 ' or name like decode(:ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id, null, ';
 where_clause_1 := ' ''%'''||','||'''%'''||'||'||':ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id'||'||'||'''%'''||')'||') ';
 where_clause := where_clause||where_clause_1;
 end if;
 set_block_property('SPONSORS',default_where,where_clause) ;
 set_block_property('SPONSORS', order_by, 'name');
 go_block('SPONSORS') ;
 :system.message_level := '5' ;
 execute_query ;
 :system.message_level := '0' ;
END;
